---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea to improve the skill
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve

Describe the specific situation where the current skill falls short. Be concrete.

## What you would like to see

Describe your proposed change or addition.

## Why this fits the project

The skill is deliberately focused on adversarial code audits. Explain how your suggestion fits that focus.

If it doesn't fit, that's fine, but say so honestly and we can discuss whether to scope it differently.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways to solve the same problem. Why this one is better.

## Have you tested a prototype

If you've already drafted a change to SKILL.md and tested it, link to the fork or paste the change here.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps us evaluate the proposal.
